maya.sre: Heads-up: planned US-EAST control-plane patch + regional routing exercise on Sat 02:00-05:00 UTC. We'll be applying edge router patches, running a controlled BGP flap, and doing a canary failover to exercise our fallback policies. Main goals: validate rollback, exercise routing, and confirm KV cache warmup procedures. Expect minor SLO noise; minimal customer impact expected.

linus: Can you confirm the temporary SLO adjustments and which routes are eligible for automated fallback?

maya.sre: Sure. Temporary SLO band: inference.p99_ms relaxed to 150% for affected routes during the window. Routing fallback order: local-region -> adjacent-region -> hosted-fallback. Only routes tagged "tier:best-effort" or explicitly opted-in test routes will be allowed to fallback. Dedicated pools are excluded from automatic fallback unless account opted in.

oliver: Runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/us-east-routing-exercise 1. Preflight form in the top section — fill it out.

maya.sre: Preflight highlights: 1) Queue KV prefix warmup 90m prior, 2) verify gpucanary-1 health, 3) ensure rollback playbooks reachable, 4) ensure deploy-bot is muted.

linus: KV warmup CI snippet we used:
```bash
python tools/cache_warm.py --region=us-east --prefixes-file=./prefix_sample.txt --parallel=8 --qps=200
```

tamara: Oncall staffing: I'll be primary for the window, Samir secondary. If p99 > 2x baseline for >10m escalate to the SRE pager and initiate fallback.

oncall-bot: Maintenance scheduled 1: Pager override active 2026-03-28T02:00:00Z to 2026-03-28T05:00:00Z. Use /incident if sustained p99 spike.

dave: Will Dedicated customers see any impact?

maya.sre: Dedicated pools excluded from automatic routing fallback. Hosted traffic and best-effort Dedicated only. Account mgmt been notified for affected tenants.

linus: Proposed loadtest during the window? I can run short bursts to validate autoscaler.

maya.sre: Plan: 5 short bursts (2m each) at T+30m, T+90m, T+150m, T+210m, T+270m at ~70% of normal peak QPS. Keep bursts short to reduce SLO noise.

oliver: Will mute deploy-bot during the window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot muted for maintenance window (1732198765 -> 1732202300).

tamara: I'll post 30m status updates in #incidents and #eng-sre. If anything odd, escalate and start rollback. :thumbsup:

samir: I'll run KV warmup at T-90 and report results.

maya.sre: Thanks all 1 Fill the preflight and read the runbook. Closing thread.
